fields.description: 8-byte ASCII save magic 'ROCKFOL0'; copied from ROM constant to record offset 0 on save and byte-compared on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08056548 copies 8-byte magic from _DAT_08056580 to buf+0 (param_2==0 path, line 7964); FUN_080566c0 byte-compares record bytes [0,8) against expected magic (lines 8044-8056); generic 8-byte verifier FUN_080598f4 invoked on the record by FUN_080569d0 (line 8188) and FUN_08055950 (lines 7576,7579).
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: 2 reserved bytes between magic and gameplay payload; never written by the serializer, zero on fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08056548 param_2==0 path writes [0,8) (magic, line 7964) then [10,0x3A) (payload, line 7944) leaving [8,10) untouched; baseline logical bytes [8,10) are zero.
fields.name: header_reserved

fields.description: 48-byte gameplay progress snapshot (stage/character progress, counters, unlocks); copied verbatim between record and live game state on save and load. Interior fields unresolved; all zero on fresh save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08056548 save path copies 0x30 bytes from live state *(_DAT_0805657c+0x50) to record offset 10 (line 7944); FUN_08055950 load path copies 0x30 bytes from record offset 10 back to live state *(_DAT+0x50) (line 7604); block transfer sized by *(u16*)(ctrl+0x30)=0x80 set in FUN_08056504 (line 7877).
fields.name: progress_state

fields.description: Zero padding between gameplay payload and trailing checksum; never written by the serializer.
fields.evidence: FUN_08056548 param_2==0 path writes payload only up to offset 0x3A (10+0x30) and checksum at 0x7E (line 7976), leaving [0x3A,0x7E) untouched; baseline logical bytes there are zero.
fields.name: record_padding

fields.description: Bitwise-NOT checksum (sum8_inv) over record bytes [0,126); verified on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08056548 accumulates byte sum over [0,iVar7) and stores ~sum at iVar7 with iVar7=0x7E (lines 7967-7976); FUN_08056ab4 re-sums [0,param_2-2) and requires *(buf+param_2-2)==~sum with param_2=0x80 (lines 8268-8277); baseline sum=0x40, stored 0xBF.
fields.name: record_checksum

fields.description: Fixed end-of-record marker stored unconditionally after the checksum byte.
fields.evidence: FUN_08056548 stores constant 0x88 at pbVar8[1] (record offset 0x7F) immediately after the checksum byte (line 7977); baseline logical byte is 0x88.
fields.name: record_end_marker

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'ROCKFOL0' save magic at record start (rev8-logical domain)
